targetText: the Prussian military camarilla had resolved upon conquest
summary: Prussian war of conquest: exposing how Prussian militarists transformed a defensive war into an aggressive annexation.
explanation: Marx exposes how the Prussian military and ruling class broke King William's solemn pledges, turning the war into imperialist territorial expansion against France.

targetText: anachronism to make military considerations the principle by which the boundaries of nations are to be fixed
summary: Critique of annexations for 'material guarantees': military boundaries breed endless future conflicts.
explanation: Marx refutes the bourgeois argument for annexing Alsace-Lorraine, demonstrating that using strategic military lines to redraw national boundaries inevitably sows the seeds for future imperialist wars.

targetText: German working class will not patiently tolerate the annexation of Alsace and Lorraine
summary: German socialist anti-annexation protest: German workers demanded an honorable peace without territorial annexations.
explanation: The German Social-Democratic Party issued a manifesto protesting the annexation of French territory, asserting proletarian solidarity over ruling-class chauvinism.

targetText: proclaimed, not as a social conquest, but as a national measure of defence
summary: The September 4 Republic: born out of imperial collapse rather than working-class revolution.
explanation: Marx cautions that the Provisional Government of National Defense was established by bourgeois politicians to preserve capitalist state power rather than enact socialist transformation.

targetText: They have not to recapitulate the past, but to build up the future. Let them calmly and resolutely improve the opportunities of republican liberty, for the work of their own class organization
summary: Building independent working-class organization: Marx's tactical advice to Parisian workers under the Provisional Government.
explanation: Marx advised French workers to utilize republican political freedoms to build independent trade unions and political organizations rather than attempting an premature insurrection before Paris was organized.

targetText: alliance of the working classes of all countries will ultimately kill war
summary: International working-class alliance against war: proletarian solidarity as the ultimate antidote to imperialist militarism.
explanation: Marx highlights that coordinated action by international workers, such as English workers pressuring their government to recognize the French Republic, is the only force capable of stopping imperialist warfare.
